brief: Goldman's TMT desk frames 3 September as an earnings day rather than a macro one. Futures are near unchanged, the only macro item is a WSJ report that the US is extending troop deployments in Iran, and WTI is up 1.5% at $92.30, so four bellwether prints set the tape and drive high dispersion. AVGO reported in line on revenue with better margins but guided FY4Q revenue below Goldman, so the stock is down 3% even though it guided AI semiconductor revenue to double in FY27 to $115bn and double again to $230bn, named Anthropic its largest FY27 customer, and said component supply is secured through FY28. Goldman stays Buy at 12x management's FY28 EPS guidance. SNOW is up roughly 25% because product revenue accelerated to 37% against a 30% guide and F3Q is guided to accelerate again, pulling MDB and DDOG higher. HPE beat and raised FY27 revenue growth to 13-17% yet fell 4%, and NTAP beat and raised FY2027 EPS to $9.73-$10.03 yet fell 8%, both against expectations the desk calls elevated, with NTAP's own guide implying second-half growth slows to high single digits.
